race.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
race.verdict: YIMMNA advanced her form on her first foray into handicap company when a clear runner-up at Southwell and looks the way to go off just a 1 lb higher mark here. Filly Eilish has a career-high mark to overcome but scored in good style at Southwell last time and rates a big threat, while in-form duo Leopards Rock and Rapide Vega can also have a say in this competitive handicap. YIMMNA (FR) FILLY EILISH (IRE) LEOPARDS ROCK
